description: The bar chart illustrates the performance of different LLaMA-2 models on the ColeG-E task, comparing their scores under various SFT (Supervised Fine-Tuning) conditions. The horizontal axis lists three LLaMA-2 models: LLaMA-2-7B, LLaMA-2-13B, and LLaMA-2-70B, while the vertical axis represents the ColeG-E score as a percentage, ranging from 0 to 50 with a linear scale and tick labels at intervals of 10. For each model, four bars are grouped together, representing different SFT conditions: no SFT (blue), +SFT on D0 (yellow with horizontal stripes), +SFT on D0, D1 (purple with diagonal stripes), and +SFT on D0, D1, D2 (red with diagonal stripes). The bars for each model are not sorted in a specific order other than being grouped by model, and the SFT conditions are consistently ordered across the models. The approximate values for the bars are as follows: for LLaMA-2-7B, the scores are around 4 (no SFT), 20 (+SFT on D0), 27 (+SFT on D0, D1), and 30 (+SFT on D0, D1, D2); for LLaMA-2-13B, the scores are around 8 (no SFT), 32 (+SFT on D0), 38 (+SFT on D0, D1), and 40 (+SFT on D0, D1, D2); and for LLaMA-2-70B, the scores are around 27 (no SFT), 44 (+SFT on D0), 48 (+SFT on D0, D1), and 50 (+SFT on D0, D1, D2). No bars are visually emphasized beyond their color and pattern coding.
